identifies the śrāddhadevatā named in the preceding context as the mother

items.question: What identity is assigned to the śrāddhadevatā in this passage?
premises: The preceding verse defines śrāddhadevatā as the deity to whom offerings go.
This verse names mātā as that deity.
items.inference: The śrāddhadevatā is identified as the mother.
uncertainties: Whether mātā refers to a specific goddess or to the mother principle in general is not specified in this verse alone.
